sentences.text: The gold-loan FAQ does not state a numeric maximum loan-to-value ratio; it says the loan amount is set as a percentage of the assessed value of the gold ornaments, within the loan-to-value ceiling permitted under the applicable regulations.
The retail loan policy says gold loans are governed by the Bank’s Gold Loan Operational Guidelines, read with the policy.

The available evidence does not provide the applicable regulations or any in-force document that states the maximum gold-loan LTV ratio, so the maximum cannot be confirmed from the provided materials.

missing.searched: Searched the Gold Loan FAQ, the retail loan policy, and the UCB responsible business conduct directions for a numeric LTV ceiling; none was stated in the provided evidence.
